domain_rationale: The deliverable is a synthesizable Verilog module whose correctness is its per-cycle register-transfer behaviour at the ports (credit flow control, arbitration, valid/ready staging), accepted by Yosys synthesis with no latches.
evidence: instruction.md: implement /app/rtl/vc_arb.v per the timing document; compiled with iverilog, synthesized with yosys synth -top vc_arb, no latch
